svg.title: Registered trials of semaglutide or tirzepatide with versus without exercise
svg.desc: Jabbit hand review of ClinicalTrials.gov, October 19, 2026: 11 randomized trials give semaglutide or tirzepatide with versus without a structured exercise program. 5 test resistance training only, 4 include aerobic exercise, 2 do not say. None has posted results. The only tirzepatide trial that says it includes aerobic exercise is a 24-person, 16-week study that has not started recruiting.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Does cardio on Zepbound or Wegovy burn more fat? No results yet
